data.title: Invitation: Meet GRASEN at the 140th Canton Fair 2026
data.subTitle: Guangdong
data.description: GRASEN will exhibit at the 140th Canton Fair in Guangzhou from October 15–19, 2026. Visit Booth 8.1G20 to discover our new 480kW Four-Gun DC Fast Charger, R Series DC chargers, AC chargers, and EV charging solutions.
data.content:
Dear Valued Partners,

We are pleased to invite you to visit GRASEN at the 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) in Guangzhou from October 15 to 19, 2026.

As one of the world’s leading international trade events, the Canton Fair brings together buyers, industry professionals, and business partners from markets around the world.

This October, GRASEN will return with a range of EV charging solutions for commercial and public charging applications — including the debut of our new Four-Gun DC Fast Charger.


What’s New at Our Booth?

New Four-Gun DC Fast Charger

Four charging guns. Up to 480kW. One powerful charging solution.

Making its debut at the 140th Canton Fair, GRASEN’s new Four-Gun DC Fast Charger delivers up to 480kW of charging power and integrates four DC charging guns into one unit, enabling up to four EVs to charge simultaneously.

Built for high-demand charging scenarios, it brings greater charging capacity and flexibility to commercial charging sites.

Be among the first to discover it at Booth 8.1G20.


R Series DC EV Chargers

GRASEN’s R Series DC EV Chargers are designed for commercial and public fast-charging applications, combining high charging performance with flexible operation.

The series is well suited for charging stations, fleet operations, commercial parking facilities, and other high-demand charging scenarios. GRASEN’s R240 solution, for example, is designed for large-scale charging hubs and supports OCPP-based integration with charging management systems.


AC EV Chargers

GRASEN’s AC EV charging solutions will also be on display, providing reliable charging options for residential, workplace, commercial parking, and destination charging applications.

Designed with smart connectivity and flexible deployment in mind, our AC chargers provide an efficient and convenient charging experience for everyday EV users. Previous GRASEN AC solutions support connectivity options including 4G, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth.


Meet Our Experts

A successful EV charging project involves more than choosing the right charger.

At the GRASEN booth, our sales and technical teams will be available to discuss your project requirements and provide professional support on product selection, charging configurations, software integration, and customized charging solutions.

Whether you are a distributor, charging point operator, project developer, installer, fleet operator, or commercial investor, we look forward to exploring new opportunities with you.


Why Choose GRASEN?

With 16 years of experience in the EV charging industry, GRASEN has continued to expand its presence in international markets.

Our capabilities include:

· 16 years of industry experience 

· Products exported to 90+ countries 

· 120+ professionals in our R&D team 

· In-house software development 

· Comprehensive after-sales service 

These capabilities enable GRASEN to provide customers with integrated support covering EV charging equipment, technology, software, and after-sales service.


Event Details

Event: The 140th China Import and Export Fair

Date: October 15–19, 2026

Booth: 8.1G20

Hall: New Energy Vehicles and Smart Mobility, Hall 8.1, Area A

Address: No. 382, Yuejiang Middle Road, Haizhu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China

See You at Booth 8.1G20

Discover our new Four-Gun DC Fast Charger, explore GRASEN’s latest EV charging solutions, and meet our team in Guangzhou.

We look forward to welcoming you at the 140th Canton Fair!
